acceptanceCriteria: package-costs.json carries a measured entry for internal/cem/corpusbinding (or the shard tool derives it), with the shard-balance check passing.
body: Residual from V1-1334 (PR #938, head 3868fd0aa): the CEM-V1-201 corpus binding test moved to the new undeclared package internal/cem/corpusbinding and takes about 2-4 minutes, but .github/cishards/package-costs.json has no entry for it, so shard balancing treats it as default cost. Expected: measured cost entry. Actual: missing.
